definitions: A fictional group or individual who combines elements of K-pop (Korean popular music) with the activity of hunting or combating demons.
Characters in a narrative who are K-pop idols or fans and also engage in supernatural combat against demonic entities.
examples: The new series features a team of K-pop demon hunters.
She dreamed of becoming one of the legendary K-pop demon hunters.
The K-pop demon hunters used their unique skills to save the city.
